plate_description: L28.png is a steel-framed industrial factory hall with exposed ceiling trusses and rows of fluorescent tube fixtures, a tan banner reading MINISCRIBE hanging center-frame. The left side has gray steel shelving stacked with brown/blue parts bins, boxes on top, and wrapped pallets on the floor. A center workbench run with blue tabletops holds hard-drive assembly parts and tool trays under hanging pneumatic hoists, with a closed roller loading-bay door and a delivery truck visible in the background. A matching bench run continues along the right side under a glass-partitioned corridor, and the floor throughout is painted gray concrete.
